docs.text:
Pukaḻēntip Pulavar’s Tamil poem in veṇpā verse of Nala and Damayantī, from the Mahābhārata, in its three kāṇḍas.

From Wikisource · Public domain

Pukaḻēntip Pulavar, Naḷaveṇpā (a medieval text), as transcribed on Tamil Wikisource by its contributors. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from Wikisource when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Licence: Public domain.
